name: 承認の議論パネル
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
ONE Japanese Lighthouse approval discussion panel LH09-0039. Original images1–2 control all geometry, source photo appearance, icon shape, fine strokes, spacing and visible empty state. Mock3 supplies exact Japanese words only; do not copy mint initial avatar or text-symbol sort arrow.
Compact white panel666x162 logical pixels, pure #FFFFFF ordinary surface/canvas, no gray/mint broad fill. Top tabs at x22 y29 baseline: ACTIVE「コメント」and inactive「すべての活動」with original spacing. Meiryo Regular14/24, no bold. Active label brand-green, thin2px underline just under active label,135deg official gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E. Neutral fine horizontal divider extends across panel at y50.
At right on tab baseline, original tiny SORT icon made of TWO separate vertical arrows in opposing directions (not a text glyph), then「古い順」Regular12/16 slate. Source optical size12px and thin #526173 stroke, right inset30px.
Below at x22,y77: ORIGINAL dark photo avatar appearance, small26px circle, not mint initials. To right at x58,y72: large WHITE empty comment textarea about586x78px, thin neutral1px border and5px corner radius. Inside top-left12px inset placeholder「コメントを追加」Regular14/24 neutral gray. No submitted comment, send button, extra toolbar or invented content.
All text zero tracking, regular weight. Preserve original clear hierarchy, source alignment and avatar crop appearance. No app shell, watermark, annotations, perspective, comparison board or decorative colors. Tight flat UI screenshot.
reviewNotes: コメント／すべての活動、古い順、コメントを追加の日本語と空入力状態を目視。元の2本の並べ替え矢印と写真アバター外観を復元、選択タブ下線のみ正式緑。白面と通常ウェイト。外側余白、厳密な写真バイト・フォント・ベクター同一性と実コメント機能は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
